PowerShell($flutter = \(Get-Command flutter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; if \($flutter\) { Write-Host "flutter: $flutter"; $flutterDir = Split-Path $flutter; $dartCandidates = @\("$flutterDir\\dart.bat", "$flutterDir\\dart", "$flutterDir\\cache\\dart-sdk\\bin\\dart.exe"\); foreach \($d in $dartCandidates\) { if \(Test-Path $d\) { Write-Host "dart found: $d" } } } else { Write-Host "flutter NOT in PATH" })
